settings.ai_global_instructions: This is a tutorial about a video production tool. Keep language clear and practical. Avoid jargon. Focus on showing the value of each feature through the lens of time savings.

aiPreferences.globalNegative: watermark, text overlay, logo, low quality, blurry, distorted, cartoon, anime

lastCustomInstructions.generate-script: Each stage section should follow: what it does, show the AI feature, why it matters. Keep each section under 60 seconds of narration.
lastCustomInstructions.generate-clips: Use screen recordings for all stage demos. AI visuals for hook and recap only.
